keys-line-1: A / D switch rails · Shift or S hold to drift · Space hold to charge a jump · W boost · Esc pause
keys-line-2: In the air: arrow keys throw the four straight tricks, 1–4 the diagonals, or drag the mouse in any of the eight directions. A gamepad uses the right stick.
landing-hint: The long tricks are the greedy ones — touch down mid-rotation and the whole combo bails.
menu-tagline: Run the night freight. Drift the bends to keep your speed, switch rails to live, and land tricks between here and the depot.
no-webgl-body: Nightrail needs WebGL, and this browser is not offering it. Try a different browser, or enable hardware acceleration in your settings.
paused-hint: Tap the screen or press Esc to resume
touch-controls-hint: Touch controls appear during the run
trick-pad: Trick pad — flick a direction to trick
tricktionary-hint: Flick a direction in the air. Each new trick in a combo raises the multiplier — repeat one and it pays half.
unlock-hint: Finish a line with cargo aboard to open the next one
